## packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## data
```{r}
## before you load the file you need to convert the results jsonl file to csv
rating_data <- read.csv("") 
word_data <- readxl::read_xlsx("") 
```

## loop
```{r}
dataset <- c("") 

for (name in dataset) {
  
  df <- get(name)
  
  # renaming relevant columns
  df <- df %>% rename(c(
  "token_1" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.0.token",
  "logprob_1" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.0.logprob",
  "token_2" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.1.token",
  "logprob_2" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.1.logprob",
  "token_3" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.2.token",
  "logprob_3" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.2.logprob",
  "token_4" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.3.token",
  "logprob_4" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.3.logprob",
  "token_5" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.4.token",
  "logprob_5" = "response.body.choices.0.logprobs.content.0.top_logprobs.4.logprob"))
  
  # keeping only relevant columns
  df <- df %>% select(c(
  "token_1",
  "logprob_1",
  "token_2",
  "logprob_2",
  "token_3",
  "logprob_3",
  "token_4",
  "logprob_4",
  "token_5",
  "logprob_5"
  ))
    
  # extracting linear probability from log-probabilities
  df$prob_1 <- exp(df$logprob_1)
  df$prob_2 <- exp(df$logprob_2)
  df$prob_3 <- exp(df$logprob_3)
  df$prob_4 <- exp(df$logprob_4)
  df$prob_5 <- exp(df$logprob_5)
  
  # computing weighted-sum
  rating <- rowSums(cbind(
    as.numeric(df$token_1) * df$prob_1,
    as.numeric(df$token_2) * df$prob_2,
    as.numeric(df$token_3) * df$prob_3,
    as.numeric(df$token_4) * df$prob_4,
    as.numeric(df$token_5) * df$prob_5), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # rounding the rating to two decimals
  df$rating <- round(rating, 2)

  # keeping only rating column
  df <- df %>% select(rating)
  
  assign(name, df)
} 
```

## combining rating with word stimuli in one df
```{r}
data <- cbind(word_data, rating_data)
```
